heading: Key Sources
title: BCCNM - Using Artificial Intelligence in Practice
note: BCCNM's learning resource for NPs: the standards that apply to AI and the questions to ask about privacy, bias, consent, and safety and transparency (evaluating AI output, accountability, over-reliance)
keywords: bccnm ai standards accountability human in the loop

heading: Key Sources
title: Island Health - AI ToolKit: AI Scribe Limitations and Mitigations
note: the known errors of AI scribes and how Island Health expects medical staff, including NPs, to catch them; also copy-and-paste guidance
keywords: ai scribe errors hallucination omission review note

heading: Key Sources
title: AAFP - The Promise and Pitfalls of AI in Primary Care
note: International source: US review (FPM 2024;31(2):27-31) of what large language models get wrong, such as fabricated content and bias, and when output is easy to verify
keywords: chatgpt large language model llm hallucination

heading: Reviewing AI-Drafted Notes
title: Northern Health - AI Ambient Scribes
note: what Northern Health requires of medical staff, including NPs, before an AI-drafted note enters the record, and which scribe features are approved and not approved (decision support, summaries, recommendations)
keywords: ambient scribe review edit note approved features

heading: Reviewing AI-Drafted Notes
title: Doctors of BC - Practical Considerations for Using AI Scribes
note: Physician-focused: Doctors Technology Office guide to choosing and implementing an AI scribe, with a section on its limitations and how to mitigate them
keywords: ai scribe implementation limitations doctors technology office

heading: Reviewing AI-Drafted Notes
title: CMPA - AI Scribes: Answers to Frequently Asked Questions
note: Physician-focused: CMPA's answers on consent, accuracy of chart entries, privacy and bias; revised December 2025, with links to each provincial college's AI guidance
keywords: cmpa medico-legal ai scribe consent accuracy
